timeline.summary: Niraj Bajaj (Promoter) declared no encumbrance on Bajaj Finserv shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regn 31(4).
Bajaj Finserv reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹38,508 Crore and PAT of ₹2,539 Crore.
Bajaj Finserv informed the exchanges about the availability of the Q4FY26 earnings call recording.
Bajaj Finserv approved changing the names of its asset management, trustee and mutual fund subsidiaries to drop 'Finserv' following SEBI approval.
Bajaj Finserv reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹38,508 Crore and PAT of ₹2,539 Crore, and announced the completion of the buyback of the 3% Allianz stake in its insurance subsidiaries.
Bajaj Finserv filed its FY2026 international investor presentation detailing group strategy and subsidiary performance.
Bajaj Finserv reported provisional monthly premium numbers for April 2026 for its unlisted insurance subsidiaries.
Bajaj Finserv reported provisional monthly premium figures for May 2026 for its unlisted insurance subsidiaries.
Bajaj Finserv approved pursuing re-insurance business through a new subsidiary subject to IRDAI approval.
Bajaj Finserv reported Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹42,037 Crore and PAT of ₹6,297 Crore.
Bajaj Finserv filed its Q1 FY2027 international investor presentation detailing group strategy and financial performance.
Bajaj Finserv Limited’s 19th AGM on July 31, 2026, approved standalone/consolidated financials for FY2026 with 99.9999% shareholder votes in favor.
Bajaj Finserv reported Q1FY27 earnings conference call transcript detailing consolidated total income of ₹42,037 crore and PAT of ₹6,297 crore.
Bajaj Finserv reported provisional July 2026 business figures for its unlisted insurance subsidiaries on August 7, 2026.
Bajaj Finserv reported provisional August 2026 insurance premium figures with general insurance GDPI at ₹2,291 Cr and life new business at ₹1,954 Cr.
2026-10-01: Board approved subscription to convertible warrants in Bajaj Finance for up to ₹5,800 Cr
Bajaj Finserv reported provisional September 2026 insurance figures with general insurance GDPI at ₹2,363 Cr and life insurance new business at ₹1,831 Cr.
On 17 October 2026, Bajaj Finserv incorporated its wholly owned subsidiary Bajaj Reinsurance Limited with a subscription of ₹1 crore.

Bajaj Finserv Limited scheduled an analysts/institutional investors conference call on **3 November 2026 at 05:00 PM IST** for Q2FY27 results, led by **Tapan Singhel (MD & CEO, Bajaj General Insurance)**, **Tarun Chugh (MD & CEO, Bajaj Life Insurance)**, and **Ashish Panchal (Group Strategy Head, Bajaj Finserv)**.
